title: solenospermum wallichii
intro: Solenospermum wallichii, commonly known as Himalayan snake root, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
